arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat
repo=/srv/lowcost-europa
owner=le001_1789265592
echo "AUDIT_BEGIN"
echo "UTC=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
echo "HOST=$(hostname)"
echo "PROJECT_DIR"
test -d "$repo" && stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' "$repo"
echo "GIT_SHA_AND_BRANCH"
sudo -n -u "$owner" git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD
sudo -n -u "$owner" git -C "$repo" branch --show-current
echo "GIT_STATUS"
sudo -n -u "$owner" git -C "$repo" status --porcelain=v1
echo "APP_FILES"
find "$repo/apps" -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name '*.py' -o -name '*.html' \) | sed "s#$repo/##" | sort | head -85
echo "PYTHON"
python3 --version
echo "ENV_DIRS"
find "$repo" -maxdepth 2 -type d \( -name venv -o -name .venv \) -print
echo "SERVICES"
for s in lowcost-europa lowcost-europa-weekly-discovery.timer lowcost-europa-catalog-maintenance.timer; do printf '%s=' "$s"; systemctl is-active "$s" || :; done
echo "TIMERS"
systemctl list-timers --all --no-pager --no-legend | grep -E 'lowcost-europa' || :
echo "RECENT_COMMITS"
sudo -n -u "$owner" git -C "$repo" --no-pager log -5 --format='%h %ad %s' --date=iso-strict
echo "AUDIT_END"
